comparison.objective: Swipe a magnetic-stripe card through a reader and return it to its stand.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient a thin card and guide it once through a narrow slot at controlled speed.
comparison.success_condition: The reader accepts a clean swipe and the released card is upright and still in its stand.
comparison.reason: Narrow-slot card guidance does not test selective many-body passage, washer retention, bimanual load sharing, or screen reseating.
